title: 9 Competitive Intelligence Tools to Trial in 2026 (Buyer’s Guide)

facts.fact: The vendor's guide was published on February 28, 2026.
The guide states that it compares 10 competitive intelligence tools, although its title refers to 9 tools.
facts.quote: In this guide, we’ll explore these questions with regard to 10 of the top competitive intelligence tools on the market today.
